name: icsr.patient
purpose: Stores basic demographic attributes of the patient for each safety report, focused on age and sex.
granularity: One row per patient per safety report.

columns.name: SAFETY_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the safety report. Functions as the distinct patient or case key in this PoC.

columns.name: ONSET_AGE
columns.description: Patient age at time of onset of reaction or event. Interpreted in years for this PoC.

columns.name: PATIENT_AGE_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Reference to the patient age group in icsr.patient_age_group.

columns.name: PATIENT_SEX_ID
columns.description: Reference to the sex category in icsr.patient_sex.
